actions.description: Searches the live web for a query. Returns an answer or structured rows, and the ranked source pages that support each value.
actions.name: webSearch

properties.description: Question or request in plain words, in any language, from 1 to 2000 characters. Accepts the operators site:, -site:, -word, -"phrase", filetype:, after: and before: (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).
properties.exampleValue: site:stripe.com who is the CEO of Stripe
properties.label: Search Query
properties.name: q

properties.description: Default reads the result pages and returns an answer, structured rows and sources. Fast returns only the search engine results with snippets in approximately 1 second, with no answer, rows or passages. Fast costs less per call.
properties.label: Search Tier
properties.name: speed

properties.description: Maximum number of sources to return: 1 to 100, or 1 to 200 when Image Search is true. If empty, the response contains all sources that the answer used.
properties.label: Number of Sources
properties.name: num

properties.description: Page of the ranked source list to return, from 1 to 10. Each page has Number of Sources results (10 if empty). Only page 1 contains the answer and the rows.
properties.label: Result Page
properties.name: page

properties.description: If true, returns text passages from the top source pages that match the query. Adds up to approximately 1 second. Do not use together with News Search.
properties.label: Return Page Passages
properties.name: passages

properties.description: If true, returns news items, newest first, instead of web results. Always uses the Fast search tier. Do not use together with Return Page Passages.
properties.label: News Search
properties.name: news

properties.description: If true, returns image results instead of web results. Always uses the Fast search tier.
properties.label: Image Search
properties.name: images

properties.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country that the results are for. SpecStream sends it to each search engine that supports a country.
properties.label: Country Code
properties.name: country

properties.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 code of the result language. SpecStream sends it to each search engine that supports a language.
properties.label: Language Code
properties.name: language

properties.description: Filter level for explicit content. SpecStream sends it to each search engine that supports one. If empty, each search engine uses its own default level.
properties.label: Safe Search Level
properties.name: safe

actions.title: Web Search

actions.description: Reads up to 20 web pages or documents (PDF, Word, Excel, EPUB) and returns the main text of each, without menus, footers and ads, as Markdown, plain text or HTML.
actions.name: extract

properties.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URLs of the web pages or documents to read, from 1 to 20. SpecStream reads a duplicate URL only once.
properties.label: Page URLs
properties.name: urls

properties.description: Format of the main text in the text field of each result.
properties.label: Text Format
properties.name: format

properties.description: Fields to add to each result: the raw page HTML, the links on the page, the HTTP response (status code and final URL after redirects), or the full page text.
properties.label: Additional Result Fields
properties.name: include

options.label: HTTP Status Code and Final URL

actions.title: Extract Page Content
